algorithm.byte_order: little-endian uint16 VRAM words in row-major upload-rectangle order
algorithm.palette_secondary: CRC-32 over 16 (4bpp) or 256 (8bpp) live CLUT words
algorithm.primary: CRC-32 over the exact VRAM upload rectangle

clean_validation.generation_invalidation: overlapping upload, fill, copy, or primitive destination invalidates tracked identities
clean_validation.hot_path: CLUT CRC is memoized until an intersecting VRAM mutation
clean_validation.native_fallback: missing, ambiguous, windowed, wrapped, stale, or malformed matches use native VRAM sampling
